lines.text: The Teacher was wise, taught the people knowledge, and arranged many proverbs, searching for accurate words of truth.
The words of the wise are like goads, and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded ropes.
Those embedded nails are driven by a single Shepherd.
The Teacher warns his son that there is no end to making many books, and much study strengthens the body.
The conclusion is to fear God and keep His commandments, for God will bring every deed into judgment.
